en: The postcard features a color illustration of a scenic alpine lake surrounded by mountains, with a prominent church featuring a tall bell tower near the water's edge. There is a bridge visible in the background and a historic building on a hill. The back of the postcard contains handwritten text, postage stamps, and several postal markings. The printed text on the front reads 'Wocheinersee in Krain.'
